answer:
The Office of National Statistics data show that **Flintshire** experienced the largest decline in domestic gas consumption among the unitary authorities listed.

| Authority | 2012 consumption (kWh) | 2023 consumption (kWh) | Drop (kWh) |
|-----------|------------------------|------------------------|------------|
| Flintshire | 12 571.0 | 9 311.5 | **3 259.5** |
| County Durham | 13 681.0 | 10 603.8 | 3 077.2 |
| Bedford | 12 713.0 | 9 922.0 | 2 791.0 |
| North Lincolnshire | 13 031.0 | 10 151.6 | 2 879.4 |
| Telford & Wrekin | 11 879.0 | 9 267.2 | 2 611.8 |

*Source: ONS “Domestic gas consumption” indicator – data table for 2012 and 2023 (unitary authorities).*

Thus, Flintshire saw the biggest drop, falling by 3,259.5 kWh from 2012 to 2023.
